definitions.explanation: A domesticated ruminant animal kept for its wool and meat. Counter: {匹|ひき} or {頭|とう}.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}の{毛|け}でセーターを{作|つく}ります。
examples.english: Sweaters are made from sheep's wool.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}を{数|かぞ}えると{眠|ねむ}くなると{言|い}われています。
examples.english: They say counting sheep makes you sleepy.

examples.japanese: {羊|ひつじ}は{群|む}れで{行動|こうどう}する{動物|どうぶつ}です。
examples.english: Sheep are animals that move in flocks.

notes: {羊|ひつじ} is one of the twelve zodiac animals ({未|ひつじ}). The meat is called {羊肉|ようにく} or mutton/lamb. Common expressions include {迷|まよ}える{羊|ひつじ} (lost sheep). {羊毛|ようもう} means wool.
